rt:param.name: Calculate_WB
rt:param.comment: предупредительная уставка рассчитывается из значения аварийной уставки

rt:param.name: WB_to_AB_ratio
rt:param.comment: соотношение уровня предупредительной уставки к уровню аварийной уставки (при Calculate_WB = true) По умолчанию = 108/111

rt:model.rt:sub:
Sub ValCalc() If pv != nothing Then Dim val As double val = pv.Value
if val <= pvRL Then FBar = 0 ElseIf val>= pvRH Then FBar = -1 ElseIf !IsLogScale Then FBar = -1 * (val - pvRL) / diap Else FBar = -1 * (Log10(val) - Log10(pvRL)) / (Log10(pvRH) - Log10(pvRL) ) End If
If (pv.Quality == PLS_QUAL_BAD) || (pv_ana.Quality == PLS_QUAL_BAD) Then FColor = Color_Inval ElseIf (val < pvRL) || (val> pvRH) Then FColor = Color_Susp ElseIf (val >= pv_ana.Value) && (val <=pvRH ) Then FColor = Color_ANA_HI_A ElseIf (Calculate_WB && (val > (WB_to_AB_ratio * pv_ana.Value)) && (val <= pv_ana.Value)) Then FColor = Color_ANA_HI_P Else FColor = M_Color End If Else FBar = -1 FColor = Color_ErLink End If ShowBoard(pv_ana.Value, AB_Group_AB_Border, AB_Group_AB_Line) If Calculate_WB Then Dim a as double // a = CDbl(CLng(WB_to_AB_ratio * pv_ana.Value)) a = CDbl(WB_to_AB_ratio * pv_ana.Value) ShowBoard(a, WB_Group_WB_Border, WB_Group_WB_Line) End If End Sub

Sub ShowScale() Dim s as string Dim s1 as string Dim Num_points as Uint dim delta as double dim i as ubyte dim y as double Dim a as double Dim b as double dim thw as float Dim PvR_stepen as string
s = "" thw = _This.width If thw <= 30 Then thw = 30 End If If !IsLogScale Then a = pvRH / 10 b = diap / 10 Num_points = CInt(b) delta = _This.height / diap //цена пикселя for i = 1 to Num_points a = CInt((pvRL + 10 * i) / 10) * 10 // что пишем до округления y = _This.height - ((a - pvRL) * delta) s = s + " M0 " + CStr(y)+ " L" + CStr(thw) + " " + CStr(y) If (i <= 30) && ShowDigits Then Digits.Child(i - 1).text = CStr(CInt(a)) Digits.Child(i - 1).y = y - 2.5 Digits.Child(i - 1).visibility = "visible" End If next i
If ShowDigits Then PvRH_Dig.visibility = "visible" PvRL_Dig.visibility = "visible" PvRH_Dig.x = thw - 15.0 PvRL_Dig.x = thw - 15.0 PvRL_Dig.y = _This.height - 2.5
If (pvRL < 1) && (pvRL > 0) Then //если мин значение меньше 1, будем показывать в формате 10 в степени PvRL_Ten.visibility = "visible" s1 = pv_R_ten(pvRL, PvR_stepen) PvRL_Ten.text = s1 PvRL_Dig.text = PvR_stepen If s1 != "10" Then PvRL_Dig.x = thw + 34.5 Else PvRL_Dig.x = thw PvRL_Ten.x = thw - 17.5 End If
//PvRL_Dig.text = CStr(Round(Log10(pvRL),0)) PvRL_Dig.font_size = 9 PvRL_Dig.y = _This.height - 10 PvRL_Ten.y = _This.height- 2.5 Else PvRL_Dig.text = CStr(pvRL) End If PvRH_Dig.text = CStr(pvRH) End If Else Num_points = Log10(pvRH) - Log10(pvRL) - 1 delta = _This.height / (Log10(pvRH) - Log10(pvRL)) for i = 1 to Num_points a = pvRL * (10 ** i) y = _This.height - ((Log10(a) - Log10(pvRL)) * delta) s = s + " M0 " + CStr(y) + " L" + CStr(thw) + " " + CStr(y) If (i <= 30) && ShowDigits Then If Round(Log10(a),0) == 0 Then Tens.Child(i - 1).text = "1" Tens.Child(i - 1).visibility = "visible" Tens.Child(i - 1).y = y - 2.5 ElseIf Round(Log10(a),0) == 1 Then Tens.Child(i - 1).y = y - 2.5 Tens.Child(i - 1).visibility = "visible" Else Digits.Child(i - 1).text = CStr(Round(Log10(a),0)) Digits.Child(i - 1).y = y - 10 Tens.Child(i - 1).y = y - 2.5 Digits.Child(i - 1).font_size = 9 Digits.Child(i - 1).visibility = "visible" Tens.Child(i - 1).visibility = "visible" End If End If next i If ShowDigits Then PvRH_Dig.visibility = "visible" PvRL_Dig.visibility = "visible" PvRH_Ten.visibility = "visible" PvRL_Ten.visibility = "visible" PvRH_Dig.x = thw PvRL_Dig.x = thw PvRL_Ten.x = thw - 17.5 PvRH_Ten.x = thw - 17.5 PvRL_Dig.y = _This.height - 10 PvRL_Ten.y = _This.height - 2.5
If (Log10(pvRL) == 0) Then PvRL_Ten.text = "1" PvRL_Dig.visibility = "hidden" ElseIf (Log10(pvRL) == 1) Then PvRL_Dig.visibility = "hidden" Else s1 = pv_R_ten(pvRL, PvR_stepen) PvRL_Ten.text = s1 PvRL_Dig.text = PvR_stepen If s1 != "10" Then PvRL_Dig.x = thw + 27.5 End If End If
If (Log10(pvRH) == 0) Then PvRH_Ten.text = "1" PvRH_Dig.visibility = "hidden" ElseIf (Log10(pvRH) == 1) Then PvRH_Dig.visibility = "hidden" Else s1 = pv_R_ten(pvRH, PvR_stepen) PvRH_Ten.text = s1 PvRH_Dig.text = PvR_stepen If s1 != "10" Then PvRH_Dig.x = thw + 27.5 End If End If End If
End If Shkala.d = s End Sub

Sub ShowBoard(ByVal board as double, ByVal B_Border as RtSvgObj, ByVal B_Line as RtSvgObj) Dim y as float Dim delta as float If (board >= pvRL) && (board <= pvRH) Then If !IsLogScale Then delta = _This.height / diap y = _This.height - (board - pvRL) * delta Else delta = _This.height / (Log10(pvRH) - Log10(pvRL) ) y = _This.height - ((Log10(board) - Log10(pvRL)) * delta)
End If B_Border.y1 = y B_Border.y2 = y B_Line.y1 = y B_Line.y2 = y B_Border.visibility = "visible" B_Line.visibility = "visible" Else B_Border.visibility = "hidden" B_Line.visibility = "hidden" End If End Sub

Function pv_R_ten (ByVal pvR as double, ByRef stepen as string) as string Dim first3 as string Dim epos as ubyte Dim num_sym as ubyte first3 = Left(PRJSPEC.CExp(pvR, 1), 3) If first3 != "1.0" Then pv_R_ten = first3 + "*10" Else pv_R_ten = "10" End If epos = InStr(1, PRJSPEC.CExp(pvR, 1), "E") num_sym = Len(PRJSPEC.CExp(pvR, 1)) - epos stepen = Right(PRJSPEC.CExp(pvR, 1), num_sym) If Left(stepen, 1) == "+" Then stepen = Right(stepen, Len(stepen) - 1) End If End Function
rt:model.rt:event:
Dim thh as double Dim thw as double Dim i as ubyte
thh = _This.height thw = _This.width InGr.y = -2.5 InGr.height = thh + 5 Backgr_frame.height = thh Backgr_rect.height = thh BotLineBorder.y1 = thh BotLineBorder.y2 = thh BotLine.y1 = thh BotLine.y2 = thh SelArea.height = thh
// ширина If thw <= 30 Then thw = 30 End If
Backgr_frame.width = thw - 25 Backgr_rect.width = thw - 25 InGr.width = thw - 20 BotLineBorder.x2 = thw TopLineBorder.x2 = thw BotLine.x2 = thw TopLine.x2 = thw WB_Group_WB_Border.x2 = thw - 15 WB_Group_WB_Line.x2 = thw - 15 AB_Group_AB_Border.x2 = thw - 15 AB_Group_AB_Line.x2 = thw - 15
For i = 0 to 30 If !IsLogScale Then Digits.Child(i).x = thw - 15.0 Else Digits.Child(i).x = thw Tens.Child(i).x = thw - 17.5 End If Next i body.width = thw - 25 SelArea.width = thw

Set pv = RTAPLS.AnaPV(FKKS1) Set pv_ana = RTAPLS.AnaPV(FKKS2) body.visibility = "visible" M_Color = Middle_Color_Wieghted(Color_ANA_GOOD, 0xcdcdcd, 0.5) If (pv == Nothing) || (pv_ana == Nothing) Then HasError = true FColor = Color_ANA_ER_LINK Exit Sub End If pvRH = pv.RangeHigh pvRL = pv.RangeLow If ((pvRL <= 0) || (pvRH <= 0)) && IsLogScale Then // не может быть логарифмический масштаб при 0 начале диапазона HasError = true FColor = Color_ANA_ER_LINK Exit Sub End IF diap = pvRH - pvRL If diap <= 0 Then HasError = true FColor = Color_ANA_ER_LINK Exit Sub End If WB_to_AB_ratio = Abs(WB_to_AB_ratio)

ShowScale() ShowBoard(pv_ana.Value, AB_Group_AB_Border, AB_Group_AB_Line) If Calculate_WB Then Dim a as double //a = CDbl(CLng(WB_to_AB_ratio * pv_ana.Value)) a = CDbl(WB_to_AB_ratio * pv_ana.Value) ShowBoard(a, WB_Group_WB_Border, WB_Group_WB_Line) End If

rect.rt:event:
If (pv == Nothing) || (pv_ana == Nothing) Then NoLink(FKKS1) ElseIf (pvRL <= 0) && IsLogScale Then // не может быть логарифмический масштаб при 0 начале диапазона ShowWarning("Нижняя граница диапазона = 0", 10) ElseIf (diap >= 300) && !IsLogScale Then ShowWarning("Слишком большой диапазон для линейного масштаба", 10) ElseIf (diap <= 0 ) then ShowWarning("Ошибка ввода данных", 10) Else Open_Win_Uni(False, "multyKKS", "Составной объект", "wi_MultyPV", FKKS1 + "|" + FKKS2 )
End If

If (pv == Nothing) || (pv_ana == Nothing) Then NoLink(FKKS1) ElseIf (pvRL <= 0) && IsLogScale Then // не может быть логарифмический масштаб при 0 начале диапазона ShowWarning("Нижняя граница диапазона = 0", 10) ElseIf (diap >= 300) && !IsLogScale Then ShowWarning("Слишком большой диапазон для линейного масштаба", 10) ElseIf (diap <= 0 ) then ShowWarning("Ошибка ввода данных", 10) ElseIf !IsLogScale Then LoadPopUpMenu(FKKS1 + "|ANAi|ws_ANA_FN " + FKKS1 + "|"+CStr(-1))
Else LoadPopUpMenu(FKKS1 + "|ANAi|ws_ANA_FN " + FKKS1 + "|"+CStr(3))
End If
